title: Irish Beef and Nutty Stir Fry
description: A hearty and flavorful stir fry dish combining tender beef and crunchy nuts with a variety of vegetables.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add beef and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Remove beef from skillet and set aside.
Add onion, garlic, and bell pepper to skillet and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add soy sauce and stir to combine.
Return beef to skillet and stir to coat with soy sauce mixture.
Add chewy and nutty to skillet and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until nuts are toasted.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
